decisions.choice: Create a separate backlog feature hub for the agent control plane
decisions.rationale: Kill switch, observability, and runtime durability cut across existing agent/session plans and need one future owner without starting implementation now.

decisions.choice: Keep existing scoped spending and session lifecycle ownership in their current hubs
decisions.rationale: agent-evolution and session-key-phase-2 already own those slices; this hub should reference them instead of duplicating their work.

decisions.choice: Limit initial queue visibility to backlog UI and state lanes
decisions.rationale: The plan should be discoverable in the hub while avoiding accidental implementation before the work is intentionally promoted.

decisions.choice: Sequence implementation as run ledger, kill switch semantics, runtime durability proof, then advanced UI
decisions.rationale: Operator controls need real state and policy primitives before UI can safely expose pause, revoke, retry, or explanation workflows.

decisions.choice: Use a dual principal model for v1 runs
decisions.rationale: Each run should record who requested it and which acting scope executed it, so authority remains legible across local runtime, delegated session, and coop-authorized work.

decisions.choice: Make observability metadata-first and local-only by default
decisions.rationale: Run ledgers must improve operability without leaking source bodies, secrets, or private context into shared/operator views.

decisions.choice: Promote a docs lane only after state and UI semantics stabilize
decisions.rationale: A durable operator reference should describe actual stop/revoke behavior, not speculative controls.
